headline: 125 goals and 68 assists: Messi retires from Argentina national team
summary: The football legend played his 208th and final game for his country in a tearful farewell at the Monumental stadium in Buenos Aires.
details: Lionel Messi officially bid farewell to the Argentina national team in his 208th and final international appearance against Benin. The legendary captain leaves the national side with a record 125 goals and 68 assists.
The match at the Monumental stadium in Buenos Aires was filled with emotion, as fans and teammates gathered to honor the player who led Argentina to a World Cup and two Copa America titles.
In a touching tribute, play was paused in the 10th minute of the match to honor the 'LM10'. Messi himself expressed his gratitude, stating, "I leave in peace. I gave everything."
Global stars including Brazil's Neymar praised Messi's contribution to the sport, with Neymar stating that the entire world should be grateful for what the Argentine had given to football.
Teammates Rodrigo De Paul and Angel Di Maria also shared emotional messages, highlighting Messi's impact not only as an athlete but as a person and a brother.
For many Argentine fans, Messi's success provided a vital refuge and joy during difficult economic times for the country.
caption:
125 goals, 68 assists, and one legendary legacy. Lionel Messi has played his final game for Argentina.

Lionel Messi officially bid farewell to the Argentina national team in his 208th and final international appearance against Benin. The legendary captain leaves the national side with a record 125 goals and 68 assists.

The match at the Monumental stadium in Buenos Aires was filled with emotion, as fans and teammates gathered to honor the player who led Argentina to a World Cup and two Copa America titles.

In a touching tribute, play was paused in the 10th minute of the match to honor the 'LM10'. Messi himself expressed his gratitude, stating, "I leave in peace. I gave everything."

Global stars including Brazil's Neymar praised Messi's contribution to the sport, with Neymar stating that the entire world should be grateful for what the Argentine had given to football.

Teammates Rodrigo De Paul and Angel Di Maria also shared emotional messages, highlighting Messi's impact not only as an athlete but as a person and a brother.

For many Argentine fans, Messi's success provided a vital refuge and joy during difficult economic times for the country.

Source: Prothom Alo, Jamuna TV, bdnews24.com

headline: 10-hour gas supply suspension in parts of Dhaka this Thursday
summary: Titas Gas has announced a planned outage from 10 AM to 8 PM for emergency pipeline repairs in several areas including Mirpur and Agargaon.
details: Titas Gas will suspend gas supply for 10 hours on Thursday, October 8, to carry out emergency repairs on the gas pipeline.
The outage will affect residential, commercial, and CNG customers from 10:00 AM to 8:00 PM.
Affected areas include Agargaon, western parts of Taltala, Shewrapara, Kazipara, and Mirpur-10.
Supply will also be suspended in Mirpur-1, Paikpara, Kallyanpur, Shyamoli, Mirpur 60 Feet, and Pirer Bag.
Additionally, areas on the right side of the road from Kallyanpur to Mirpur-1 will experience a total outage.
Titas Gas warned that adjacent areas may experience low gas pressure during this period.
The authority has expressed regret to the customers for the temporary inconvenience caused by the emergency repair work.
caption:
Heads up, Dhaka residents! A 10-hour gas outage is coming to several areas this Thursday.

Titas Gas will suspend gas supply for 10 hours on Thursday, October 8, to carry out emergency repairs on the gas pipeline.

The outage will affect residential, commercial, and CNG customers from 10:00 AM to 8:00 PM.

Affected areas include Agargaon, western parts of Taltala, Shewrapara, Kazipara, and Mirpur-10.

Supply will also be suspended in Mirpur-1, Paikpara, Kallyanpur, Shyamoli, Mirpur 60 Feet, and Pirer Bag.

Additionally, areas on the right side of the road from Kallyanpur to Mirpur-1 will experience a total outage.

Titas Gas warned that adjacent areas may experience low gas pressure during this period.

The authority has expressed regret to the customers for the temporary inconvenience caused by the emergency repair work.
